x: Other point-scorers for us were Bailey (100 yards), Vickers (880 yards), and Barker (220 yards). In view of the promise of our junior members, and their need for experience and competition in their own class, we shall have to seriously consider an extension of our junior programme next season.
Alan Sexton also won the discus event and is proving to be quite an all-round athlete. Results were as follows— 220 yards: 1, Barker;; 2, J.
Javelin: 1st, Bergvalds; 2nd, Sutton; 3rd, Bateman. Long Jump: 1st, Bateman; 2nd, Bergvalds; 3rd, Barker.
100 yards: 1, Lowers; 3, Barker, 10.7 secs. 220 yards: 4th, Hill. 440 yards: 3rd, Heathfield; 4th, E. Bishop. 880 yards: 2nd, Adams; 4th, Kennedy.

Geoff Barker was second in the 100 yards Senior and Dicky Bartlett won a straight 220 yards Senior. Ian Badiali won the 880 yards in 2min. 0.8secs. with Don Maclean in third place, while Bill Lucas beat Len Adams in the Senior mile after a good race with Fieldsend of Mitcham A.C.
